Application Data.NAME: John's Cleaners
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: John's Cleaners specializes in providing high-quality dry cleaning and laundry services, including shirt laundering, garment pressing, and minor alterations. Our facility is equipped with modern, environmentally-friendly dry cleaning machines and follows strict chemical safety protocols to ensure the safe handling of cleaning agents. We offer convenient pickup and delivery services to our clients, emphasizing customer satisfaction and care for their garments. Our team is trained in using advanced equipment, which is regularly maintained to minimize downtime and ensure optimal performance.
